qa_pairs.question: What are the specific characteristics of the /nearline service on the Narval cluster regarding file backups and tape migration?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Narval cluster, files on /nearline are backed up daily. However, not all files are necessarily migrated to tape; only the oldest and largest files are selected for tape migration.

qa_pairs.question: How does the /nearline service on the Nibi cluster handle the creation of tape copies and the retention of disk copies?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Nibi cluster, it may take longer than 24 hours for the first tape copy of data to be created. Additionally, the disk copy of a file will not be erased (leaving only the tape copies) until 60 days have passed.
